# RE2 Unicode reference tables

The production tables `unicode_groups.cc` and `unicode_casefold.cc` come from
[google/re2 tag 2023-09-01](https://github.com/google/re2/tree/2023-09-01/re2),
using Unicode 15.0.0. Their BSD license is retained in `LICENSE`; these files
and generated `src/core/regex/unicode_data.mbt` are third-party data, not covered
by this repository's CC0 dedication.

`scripts/gen-regex-unicode.py` translates them to pure MoonBit. The `probes-15.1`
subdirectory retains tables from [tag 2025-11-05](https://github.com/google/re2/tree/2025-11-05/re2)
for reproducible boundary inputs generated by `scripts/gen-regex-unicode-corpus.py`.
Expected results are independently captured from SQL Server, not from RE2.

The 15.1 boundary probes exposed differences at CJK Extension I, new ideographic
description characters and three additional case-fold pairs. SQL Server
17.0.5005.3 agrees with the older 15.0 tables at those captured boundaries.
